scope: Exploratory ISIC2018 Training GroundTruth comparison; 100 pairs, all canonical IDs overlap the native teacher pool
ignore_definition: label 255 counted as non-lesion over the full grid
averaging: mean per-image pixel accuracy; equals pooled pixel accuracy because each image has the same grid
comparability_limits: These 100 references are from ISIC2018 Training_Input, previously consulted in historical evaluation, and overlap the teacher pool by ID.
Not an independent test and not a direct comparison with SLED's ISIC2018 test split.
SLED paper evaluates at 768x560 after artifact preprocessing and color constancy; this audit scores outputs on a 224x224 full frame.
